damage_creature: retain allocation controller, activation/legacy source distinctions, cached source state/type, dynamic rereads after callbacks, picture/color ordering, combat/PW metadata and native record-prefix target scan.

effect_damage: only restructure four shared-label jumps and replace placeholder locals. Preserve prevention versus damage target selection, live target rereads, cached damage amount, infect/wither, PW overflow and player trap/life/token paths.

after_damage: preserve flag removal before death decisions, exile/bury/destroy precedence, unsigned damage comparison, deferred Archangel counters, live card counts and separate EVENT_AFTER_DAMAGE pass.
scope: Readability recovery of four existing native-derived bodies. This batch adds no native-function coverage and makes no new gameplay-equivalence claim. Target build and existing fixed-veneer/source-name checks are the acceptance gate. Unusual native record-prefix scan and opaque engine calls are preserved.
